import React from "react"; import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; import { FiHeart, FiTarget, FiGlobe, FiArrowRight, FiCode, FiLayout, FiDatabase } from "react-icons/fi"; const team = [ { name: "Wissam", role: "Lead Developer & Designer", initials: "W", color: "bg-purple-600" }, { name: "Frontend Team", role: "React & Tailwind CSS", initials: "FT", color: "bg-blue-600" }, { name: "UX Team", role: "User Experience & Design", initials: "UX", color: "bg-pink-600" }, ]; const techStack = [ { icon: FiCode, name: "React 18", desc: "Component-based UI library" }, { icon: FiLayout, name: "Tailwind CSS", desc: "Utility-first styling" }, { icon: FiDatabase, name: "React Router v6", desc: "Client-side navigation" }, { icon: FiGlobe, name: "Vercel", desc: "Deployment & hosting" }, ]; const About = () => { return (
{/* Hero */}

About EventHub

We believe every great memory starts with an event. EventHub is your platform to discover, create, and experience events that matter to you.

{/* Mission cards */}
{[ { icon: FiTarget, title: "Our Mission", desc: "To make event discovery and creation effortless for everyone — from local meetups to large-scale conferences. We connect communities through shared experiences.", color: "purple", }, { icon: FiHeart, title: "Our Values", desc: "Community-first design. We build for people who want to connect, learn, and celebrate together. Accessibility and simplicity are non-negotiable.", color: "pink", }, { icon: FiGlobe, title: "Our Vision", desc: "To become the go-to platform for events across Lebanon and the Arab world — where every organizer can reach their audience and every person can find their tribe.", color: "blue", }, ].map((item) => (

{item.title}

{item.desc}

))}
{/* Story */}

Our Story

EventHub started as a university project with a simple observation: finding events in Beirut was scattered across dozens of Instagram pages, WhatsApp groups, and word-of-mouth. There had to be a better way.

Built using modern web technologies — React, Tailwind CSS, and React Router — EventHub is a fully responsive, frontend-only application that demonstrates how powerful a well-designed single-page app can be without any backend infrastructure.

What started as an academic exercise grew into a fully functional prototype that could realistically serve as the foundation for a production-ready event management platform.

{/* Tech Stack */}

{t.desc}

))}

{member.name}

{member.role}

))}
{/* CTA */}

Join the Community

Start discovering events or create your own today.
